memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "He shall purify the house with the bird's blood, the fresh water, the live bird, the cedar wood, the hyssop and the scarlet yarn. Then he is to release the live bird in the open fields outside the town. In this way he will make atonement for the house, and it will be clean." - Lev 14:52-53 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The chapter ends where the cleansing began — with a bird released into open sky.

Picture the family standing in front of their home, watching it go. Their house had been shut up, inspected, scraped, rebuilt. There had been fear and disruption and real cost. And now a living bird, marked with blood, climbing away over the fields.

It will be clean. That is the last word over that home.

We need this picture, because so much of Christian life is spent in the middle of the process — the examining, the removing, the waiting. It can feel as though the work will never finish. But God brings things to completion. There is a released bird at the end.

And the release is not into a cage. Into the open fields. Freedom, distance, gone.

That is what God has done with our sin. As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us (Ps 103:12). Not managed. Not filed away. Removed.

Whatever God has been doing in your life or your home, He is working towards that open sky. Christ has not set you free in order to keep you anxious. It is for freedom that Christ has set us free (Gal 5:1).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you living in the middle of the process, forgetting there is an end?
2. What has God removed from your life that you are still carrying?
3. What would freedom actually look like for you this week?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You finish what You start and that You remove my sin as far as the east is from the west. Let me live in the freedom Christ has bought, not in old anxiety. Amen.
